Name: PID_LadderDiagram
Code:
(* ==============================================
   PID Controller — Ladder Diagram (LD)
   
   Demonstrates PID control using the Ladder Diagram
   PID function block. Enable this program and disable
   the ST version to switch control to LD mode.
   ============================================== *)

RUNG "PID Control Loop"
  CONTACT NO PID.Enabled
  PID Process.Temperature Process.Setpoint Process.HeaterOutput 2.0 0.5 0.1 0 100
END_RUNG

RUNG "Process Simulation — Heating"
  CONTACT NO PID.Enabled
  MOVE Process.HeaterOutput Process.SimInput
END_RUNG
